A '''medical facility''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. [[Darth Malgus]] went to this facility after the [[Sacking of Coruscant]] to find his lover [[Eleena Daru]].
